title: Robust Taylor-Lagrange Control for Safety-Critical Systems with Guaranteed Feasibility
abstract: arXiv:2602.20076v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The Control Barrier Function (CBF) method has been widely adopted in solving safety-critical control problems. However, the existence of a CBF is only a sufficient condition for system safety. The recently proposed Taylor-Lagrange Control (TLC) method addresses this limitation by providing a necessary and sufficient condition, but it is still vulnerable to the feasibility preservation problem (e.g., due to the inter-sampling effect when time is discretized). In this paper, we propose a robust TLC (rTLC) method to address the feasibility preservation problem and show how to use it to solve optimal control problems. Specifically, the rTLC method expands the safety function to an order higher than its relative degree using Taylor's expansion with Lagrange remainder, which allows the control to explicitly show up at the current time instead of a future time in the original TLC method. This implies that the safety constraint remains

translated_title: 具有可行性保证的安全关键系统鲁棒Taylor-Lagrange控制
translated_abstract: 控制屏障函数（CBF）方法已被广泛应用于解决安全关键控制问题。然而，CBF的存在只是系统安全的充分条件。最近提出的Taylor-Lagrange控制（TLC）方法通过提供充要条件解决了这一局限性，但它仍然容易受到可行性保持问题的影响（例如，当时间被离散化时由于采样间效应引起的问题）。本文提出了一种鲁棒TLC（rTLC）方法来解决可行性保持问题，并展示了如何利用它来求解最优控制问题。具体而言，rTLC方法使用带拉格朗日余项的泰勒展开将安全函数展开到高于其相对阶的阶数，这使得控制输入在当前时刻显式出现，而不是像原始TLC方法中那样在未来时刻才出现。这意味着安全约束保持（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出鲁棒Taylor-Lagrange控制（rTLC）方法，利用带拉格朗日余项的高阶泰勒展开使控制输入在当前时刻显式出现，从而解决安全关键系统中的可行性保持问题，并可用于求解最优控制问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a robust Taylor-Lagrange Control (rTLC) method that uses higher-order Taylor expansion with Lagrange remainder to make the control input appear explicitly at the current time, thereby guaranteeing feasibility preservation for safety-critical systems and enabling optimal control problem solving.
